reverence_level.description: Reverence level for 0db on the meter (dBu or similar, depending on calibration).

columns.description: Number of columns to use when displaying several meters in the UI.

jack_name.description: Unique identifier name to register with the JACK system.

meter_type.description: Type of meter visualization. Allowed values: vu, ppm, dpm, jf, sco.

ports.description: List of JACK port names to monitor. Use placeholder 'x' for unconnected meters if no real ports are available.
